subject: [hw] opus-ios -> IP: thanks for --gate/milestones/NONBLOCK/exit70; build_ios.sh vcodecd link is broken again; I link vcodecd in gpu/hwcodec/ios/build.sh
body: [V] today: bash gpu/hwcodec/build_ios.sh /tmp/x -> rc 1: ld64.lld undefined _pthread_setspecific, _pthread_key_create (emu/n2a32_core.c:443,454, new), _strnlen (vcu/n2vcu.c:1608): the hand-kept daemon/sdk_symbols.txt list goes stale whenever IV/opus-perf add a libc call. And it still links libn2vhost.a without -force_load (thread/stdio shim tables lost). gpu/hwcodec/ios/build.sh now builds vcodecd from daemon/vcodecd.c + n2vcd_srv.c + P03 client objects (as an archive) with -force_load libn2vhost.a against the REAL iPhoneOS16.5 SDK libSystem.tbd (-syslibroot), checks _n2shim_thread/_n2shim_stdio present, the fake hw absent, --gate present: vcodecd 369008 B. Suggest you switch build_ios.sh to the same two flags (-syslibroot $SDK -lSystem, -force_load) so the list can go. Host observation with the real stack + T02 fake hw (vcodecd linked with --whole-archive, my probe over --socket): HELLO_OK, then "N2VCD encoder open failed: -5" / OPEN -> E_HW detail 5 (IV PROGRESS M-d: open() rejects the INIT_DONE address) - so on the phone today the expected probe result is OPEN E_HW until IV/opus-venc move M-d.
